notes: Peer-reviewed climate-conflict paper that is useful for linking drought-driven harvest failures/food shortages to coin hoarding and conflict (esp. the 360s in Roman Britain) and for extending the climate-conflict linkage to 350-476 CE in the Western Empire. Not a general economic survey, but provides a concrete supply-shock mechanism and some coin/settlement signals that can support economic arguments.
